integrated_multimodal_description:
This is a standard vertical 9:16 portrait video. The sky must be at the very top of the frame, the ground and crowds at the very bottom. The frame is NOT rotated — the horizon stays perfectly level and horizontal, gravity points straight down, and the camera is held upright, never tilted sideways. Absolutely forbidden: horizontal composition, any 90-degree rotation of the frame, sideways or tilted ground, a tilted horizon, the sky appearing at the side of the frame, or vertical pillars rendered lying horizontally. [Shot 1] Cinematic live-action xianxia style, medium close-up of a fictional xianxia character in flowing vermilion robes standing within a vast, dark blue cavern carved into a floating mountain, illuminated by cold blue ambient mist and high-contrast warm gold light sources. The scene features strict central-axis symmetry with three-tier spatial layers: rough dark blue stone pillars framing the foreground, a churning sea of clouds and glowing mineral veins in the midground, and a grand celestial palace silhouette in the distant background. The camera executes a slow orbit around the subject with small amplitude at slow speed, maintaining a vertical orientation while shifting perspective to reveal the environment. Initially, the subject stands before a massive golden chain bridge, palm holding a glowing gold crystal that pulses with dense, brightening light patterns, symbolizing sustained investment growth. As the camera orbits, three mineral veins awaken behind the subject: a jet-black coal crystal facet ignites with sharp prismatic light, a deep obsidian oil fountain erupts in streams of liquid gold light, and a cyan-blue gas flame rises in turbulent, ethereal columns. These three light sources converge into a single, taut golden chain stretching across the floating islands, representing a stable industrial chain. The subject presses their hand firmly onto the chain, turning their body three-quarters toward the lens with a resolute, calm expression, their robes static and dignified. The lighting creates a strong contrast between the cold blue-gray environment and the warm gold accents on the subject's costume and the mineral lights, with soft bokeh blurring the distant floating islands and light streams. The texture of the rough stone contrasts with the smooth silk of the robes and the cold metallic sheen of the chain links. The visuals play as off-screen voiceover narration while lips remain completely closed. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

overall_soundscape:
A deep, resonant hum of ancient stone and shifting tectonic plates blends with the soft, ethereal rush of cloud mist. The sound of crystalline energy igniting creates sharp, high-pitched chimes that harmonize with the low, rolling boom of liquid gold flowing. The chain tightening produces a subtle, metallic clink that resonates with stability and weight, all underscored by a faint, sweeping wind that carries the atmosphere of a heavenly realm. The audio is clean, immersive, and devoid of any human speech or modern noise, focusing purely on the elemental and mystical textures of the environment.
